desc: Derive the convolution identity: for present B, the number of triplets centered at B is `(conv[2*B] - 1) // 2`.
Confirm ordered endpoint pairs in self-convolution require diagonal removal and division by two.
Implement membership storage using a set for sparse fallback and an NTT coefficient array for main computation.
Implement exact NTT convolution sized to cover sums through `2*max(S)`.
Add an adaptive sparse O(N²) unordered-endpoint enumeration fallback for small N.
Validate input/output behavior and public sample cases.
